## Research question

What uncertainty should this work reduce?

## Evidence required

- [ ] Source data or benchmark identified
- [ ] Provenance recorded
- [ ] Calibration level stated
- [ ] Validation metric defined

## Artifact contract

List the files this task should create or update.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Result is reproducible from committed config or documented external source
- [ ] Limits and assumptions are written in the audit or report
- [ ] Claims do not exceed the available evidence level

## Risks

Data bias, prompt sensitivity, model drift, or interpretation risks.
